messages:
devon: Quick dump of kite-embed bringup tests — ran quantization sweep (fp16 → int8 per-tensor/per-channel), recall@1/5/10 on wiki+stackquery holdouts. initial result: int8 per-tensor recall@10 down 0.06 (0.88→0.82). logs attached below. cc @maya @sameer :eyes:

maya: Can you paste exact eval command and the model hash?

devon: ```
./eval_embeddings.py --model kite-embed-v1 --quant int8-perchannel --datasets wiki_holdout,stackq --knn 1,5,10 --kmeans 1000 --seed 42 --output /tmp/kite_int8.json
```

sameer: thanks. which faiss index? hnsw? pq?

devon: HNSW, efSearch=128, nlist=0 (flat HNSW). Also re-ran with IVF+PQ (nlist=4096, m=64) — recall drop worse with PQ.

ria: Do we have per-class or per-length breakdowns? short queries often worse with quant.

devon: Yes — short <8 tokens recall@1 fell 0.12. medium 8-32 tokens fell 0.03. Attached microtable: /tmp/kite_int8_breakdown.csv

maya: Plot similarity distribution? maybe quant pushes embeddings closer to origin causing cos dist shrink.

devon: silhouette score fell 0.08; centroid norms compressed ~12%. Cosine shift histogram: mean delta -0.04.

sameer: @devon could this be addressed by per-channel scales? which quant lib used?

devon: Used onnxruntime/qlinearperchannel fallback via our quant pipeline. Per-channel better than per-tensor but still ~0.03 recall drop.

ria: Suggest test: calibrate with per-layer scale-factoring or bias correction. Also try L2-normalize post-quant or mix-precision for final proj layer.

maya: Can you run a quick ablation: int8 for all but last proj in fp16? small script maybe?

devon: On it. queuing job now. ETA ~45m. Job id: job-3112. Will post results.

ops-bot: Job job-3112 started on cluster-gpu-7 (p3.2xlarge).

sameer: If ablation helps, may roll to canary with 5% traffic. Also add regression test in CI that checks recall delta < 0.02 on our holdout.

devon: Agreed. created ticket INFR-1287. Tagging @platform to add automated eval step. :thumbsup:

devon: Results posted: int8-mix (last layer fp16) recovered recall@10 to 0.879 (~0.001 down). saved to /artifacts/kite_mix_v1.json :party:
